The historical inventory reports nitrous-oxide and methane outputs as annualized December endpoint rates. These rates describe the model state at the endpoint; they are not calendar-year integrals or cumulative emissions over 2016–2023.

## Nitrous-oxide endpoint rates

![December 2023 annualized N~2~O-N rate by county for annual crops and woody perennial crops. Values are native nitrogen mass per year.](assets/carb-results/inventory-n2o-county.webp){#fig-inventory-n2o-county .lightbox fig-alt="Paired California county maps showing December 2023 annualized nitrous-oxide nitrogen rates for annual and woody perennial crops"}

County totals reflect both the modeled per-hectare rate and the represented agricultural area. The annual and woody crop classes have similar ensemble-mean totals at the December 2023 endpoint, but the spatial distributions differ.

## Change in endpoint rate, 2016–2023

![Change in the annualized N~2~O-N endpoint rate from January 2016 to December 2023. Positive values indicate a higher annualized endpoint rate in December 2023.](assets/carb-results/inventory-n2o-change.webp){#fig-inventory-n2o-change .lightbox fig-alt="Paired California county maps showing change in annualized nitrous-oxide nitrogen rate from 2016 to 2023"}

Most represented counties show a higher modeled annualized endpoint rate in December 2023 than in January 2016. This is a change between two endpoint rates; it is not the total nitrogen emitted during the intervening years.

## Methane and complete gas accounting

Historical methane endpoint estimates are small relative to ensemble variability and do not support a useful spatial map. For the future configurations, corrected statewide methane and complete annual gas series are not presented. The scenario report therefore shows annual native-N accounting for the reference and management configurations without combining it with soil-carbon stock changes or converting it to a partial CO~2~-equivalent total.

See [Future Management and Climate Scenarios](scenarios.qmd) for the annual N~2~O-N results.
